Step 1: Setting Up the HTML Content Structure
Once you have basic html structure setup, most webpage content starts with the following skeleton:

items: <head> stores information about the page, including its title
<body> is where all visible content lives

blocks.content: This is the base we'll build on — nothing more, nothing less.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
